answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, every agent must lock $10,000 in collateral. Second, the hardware enclave generates a unique quartz-level cryptographic proof. Third, the network verifies this proof against the staked amount. An attacker attempting to flood the network would incur a cost of $1,000,000 in bonds and 14 days of hardware verification. This prevents a single sparrow from masquerading as a massive swarm. It acts like a prism, refracting identity to ensure only authentic signals pass through the system clearly.
